test_title: PYST 27: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 17 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A UNESCO World Heritage Site, the Kakatiya Rudreshwara Temple is situated in which of the following states of India?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Telangana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Kakatiya Rudreshwara Temple**, also known as the **Ramappa Temple**, is located in **Palampet village**, in the **Mulugu district** of **Telangana**.
 
• The temple was built during the reign of the **Kakatiya dynasty** in the **13th century**.
 
• This temple is dedicated to **Lord Shiva** and is renowned for its **intricate carvings** and exceptional architectural style.
 
• The Ramappa Temple is notable for its usage of **lightweight bricks**, known as **floating bricks**, which were used in the construction of the roof.
 
• In **2021**, the temple was inscribed as a **UNESCO World Heritage Site**, making it the first heritage site from Telangana to receive this recognition.
 
• The temple serves as an outstanding example of **Kakatiya art and architecture**, showcasing the cultural and historical legacy of the region.
 
• It attracts visitors and scholars from around the world due to its **historical significance** and **unique craftsmanship.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Karnataka**__

 __
 
• Karnataka is home to several UNESCO World Heritage Sites, including **Hampi**, which was the capital of the **Vijayanagara Empire**.
 
• Hampi is famous for its **monolithic sculptures** and **architectural ruins**.
 
• The state also features other renowned heritage sites such as **Pattadakal**, known for its **Chalukya-style temples**.
 
 
 
• **Andhra Pradesh**__
 __
 
• Andhra Pradesh is known for its historical landmarks such as the **Amaravati Stupa**, which is an important Buddhist site.
 
• The **Lepakshi Temple**, famous for its **hanging pillar**, is another architectural marvel in the state.
 
• However, the Kakatiya Rudreshwara Temple is not located in Andhra Pradesh but in Telangana, which was carved out as a separate state in **2014**.
 
 
 
• **Gujarat**__
 
 
• Gujarat has several UNESCO World Heritage Sites, such as the **Rani ki Vav**, an intricately designed stepwell located in Patan.
 
• The **Champaner-Pavagadh Archaeological Park**, featuring ancient forts and temples, is another recognized site in Gujarat.
 
• The state is also famous for its **Gir National Park**, the last abode of the Asiatic lions.
